name: discord
description: Discord bot-token bridge for guild, channel, and message operations.

fields.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
fields.label: Discord bot token
instructions: Create or open a Discord application, add a bot user, reset/copy the bot token, and invite the bot to the target server.
Grant the bot only the permissions it needs: View Channels, Read Message History, Send Messages, and any thread permissions you choose to add later.

fields.name: DISCORD_ALLOWED_GUILD_IDS
fields.label: Allowed Discord guild IDs (optional comma-separated allowlist)
instructions: Optional safety allowlist. When set, tools refuse guild-scoped operations outside these guild IDs.

errorHints.401: Token rejected. Make sure this is a Bot token, not an OAuth user token or client secret.
errorHints.403: Token authenticated but cannot access this endpoint. Check bot configuration.
errorHints.429: Discord rate-limited validation. Wait for Retry-After and try again.
